resources.string: Uploads finished rides to your own Strava account – only if you connect it here. Without a connection, everything stays on your device.
After you finish a recording, in the background, as soon as there’s a connection.
The upload includes the ride’s name, track, times and elevation, plus heart rate, cadence and power where measured. Who can see it on Strava depends on your Strava privacy settings.
Trailscape will stop uploading and forget the access. Rides you’ve already uploaded stay on Strava.
Strava ended the access. Rides are no longer uploaded – reconnect to continue.
Strava didn’t grant access. Nothing was connected.
Without the “Upload your activities” permission, Trailscape can’t upload anything. Reconnect and leave the box ticked.
The Strava sign-in has expired or doesn’t match. Please reconnect.
Connecting to Strava failed. Check your internet connection and try again.
No browser found to open the Strava sign-in.
The device’s secure storage isn’t available. Trailscape can’t store the Strava access.
This ride is already on Strava.
Strava isn’t accepting uploads right now. Try again later.
The Strava access is no longer valid. Reconnect Strava under Settings → Strava.
